title: Quality Studio Analysis Core Package
summary: Implemented decision dossier for the in-process Quality Studio analysis package. It inventories the current API, UI, CLI, and core boundaries; answers that the core is independently useful; recommends keeping it in this repository for now; and records the publishable package plus quality-cli proof slice.

decisions.question: Is the analysis core useful without the Quality Studio UI?
decisions.answer: Yes. AGT-2655 pipeline steps, quality-cli, and CI are standalone consumers.

decisions.question: Should the core be extracted to its own repository now?
decisions.answer: No. Keep the package here until release cadence, compatibility, cross-repository automation, and public-repository policy justify extraction.
